# appdynamics_synthetic_web_job (Data Source)

Retrieves the full detail of one Synthetic Web Monitoring job by application_id + job_id. Use the appdynamics_synthetic_web_jobs data source to discover job_id values. Shares its type name with the managed resource -- resource "appdynamics_synthetic_web_job" and data "appdynamics_synthetic_web_job" are separate namespaces.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_synthetic_web_job" "homepage" {
  application_id = 602
  job_id         = "4af8bead-8ad9-4668-a073-4accf2f48079"
}

output "homepage_schedule" {
  value = data.appdynamics_synthetic_web_job.homepage.schedule_run_configs_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application the Browser RUM app is associated with.
- `job_id` (String) ID of the job to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `app_key` (String)
- `browser_codes` (List of String)
- `chrome_versions` (List of String)
- `composable_config_json` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `location_codes` (List of String)
- `network_profile_json` (String)
- `performance_criteria_json` (String)
- `schedule_run_configs_json` (String)
- `script_json` (String)
- `timeout_seconds` (Number)
- `url` (String)
- `user_enabled` (Boolean)
- `version` (Number)
